description: Re-allocate perfect-match pre-pass pinned newer date-code stock regardless of FIFO — older lots/boxes stranded (outdated-stock risk)
reproSteps: Demand qty exactly equals a newer date-code lot/box while older stock exists → Re-allocate pins the newer source instead of FIFO-consuming the oldest
remarks: Fixed by spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-allocation-dock-match-ordering-design.md (qty perfect match now gated to oldest dock date code; shelf lots pure FIFO); retest in UAT

description: Picking Re-allocate rebuilt other orders sharing the same part numbers instead of only the selected order — their allocations were silently reshuffled
reproSteps: Open picking order A, press Re-allocate → orders B/C with the same part numbers also get their allocation rows wiped and rebuilt (priority/FIFO re-split)
remarks: Fixed in commit 5b504f4e (11-05) — Re-allocate is now strictly single-order (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-picking-reallocate-single-order-design.md); receiving confirm-arrival keeps the part-key scope by design; retest in UAT

description: Pick scan crashed with a database error when the stock source had no lot code / COO / COW and the scanned label didn't carry that field — operator could not scan-pick the line
reproSteps: Allocate stock whose lot (or receiving item) has NULL lot_code/coo/cow, then scan-pick without that field on the label → 500 with a malformed INSERT (empty VALUES slots)
remarks: Fixed in commit f73b3a0e (11-05) — nullable source attrs now fall back to NULL instead of undefined in the package insert (regression test added); latent since 2026-10-08; retest in UAT
